name: flashinfer_contest_l1_064_mla_kv_expand
author: flashinfer
description: DeepSeek-V3/Kimi-K2 KV expansion: FlashInfer rmsnorm on (B*S, 512) compressed KV, then bf16 kv_b projection and split into k_nope/value.

sources.content:
import torch
import flashinfer.norm as fn

NUM_HEADS = 128
QK_NOPE = 128
V_HEAD = 128


@torch.no_grad()
def run(compressed_kv, kv_a_layernorm_weight, kv_b_proj_weight, eps):
    b, s, lora = compressed_kv.shape
    flat = compressed_kv.reshape(-1, lora).contiguous()
    normed = fn.rmsnorm(flat, kv_a_layernorm_weight, eps)
    expanded = normed @ kv_b_proj_weight.t()
    kv = expanded.view(b, s, NUM_HEADS, QK_NOPE + V_HEAD).transpose(1, 2)
    k_nope = kv[..., :QK_NOPE].contiguous()
    value_states = kv[..., QK_NOPE:].contiguous()
    return k_nope, value_states
